name: Healthcare
key_conventions: NHS and other UK healthcare employers often use a structured supporting statement that addresses each point in the person specification (Essential and Desirable criteria) directly
Clear evidence of patient safety awareness, safeguarding knowledge, and confidentiality is commonly valued
Relevant clinical or information governance training is often listed explicitly where applicable
regulatory_considerations: Roles involving patient data are commonly subject to information governance and data protection requirements (e.g. NHS Information Governance standards, UK GDPR)
Many UK healthcare roles require a Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check
terminology_notes: 'Person specification' — the document listing Essential and Desirable criteria a candidate is expected to address
'Information governance' — how patient and health data is handled securely and appropriately
source_note: General conventions only, based on common healthcare-sector recruitment practice — individual employers, trusts, and roles vary, and the specific job description or person specification should always take priority.
